mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_id, c.post_id, c.user_id, c.content, c.is_anonymous AS anonymous, c.created_at, CASE WHEN c.is_anonymous = 1 THEN '익명' ELSE u.user_name END AS author_name FROM comments c JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY c.created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments (post_id, user_id, content, is_anonymous) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId}, #{content}, #{anonymous})
